composition_variation: Invent a poised beautiful 29-year-old adult woman with long chocolate-brown waves half tied by a pale-blue ribbon, golden amber eyes, elegant slightly elongated face, softly defined adult cheekbones and a cheerful easy smile. Opaque cobalt-blue sleeveless round-neck blouse with delicate cloth gathers, cream tailored normal mid-thigh shorts and simple white flat sandals. She sits sideways on a broad low garden step. One hand rests on the nearer knee, the other supports her naturally on the step beside her hip; both knees point diagonally to the same side, one foot on the lower step and one foot beside it. Torso turns gently toward camera, shoulders relaxed. Use a close three-quarter seated portrait from head to just below knees, not a wide full-body shot, so her face remains as beautifully readable as the uploaded reference. Cobalt fabric and dark-brown hair against luminous turquoise atmosphere, warm pale stone, rich yellow flowers, emerald shadows and small orange petals. Hair edges glow gold in strong summer sunlight. Fine expressive eyes, delicate colored contours and natural luminous skin. Secure comfortable clothing, no exaggerated pose or low-angle view. Focus on the same airy sunlit garden beauty with a clearly new seated composition.
